items.text: Dear players,
A new Open Beta patch (versions 01.08.05) is now available for Tour de France 2025 on PC only!

notes.title: How to join the Open Beta

items.text: Open Steam > Go to your Library
Right-click on Tour de France 2025 > Click Properties
Go to the Betas tab and select open-beta from the dropdown menu
👉 Please add \[OPEN BETA] in your message title when reporting bugs or feedback. Thanks for helping us test and improve the game! 🚴‍♂️
Fixed: opponents no longer stop chasing breakaways when a player’s cyclist stays at the front of the peloton to artificially let the gap increase.

Dear players,
After a few days in Open Beta, the major patch (versions 01.08) is going live and is now available for everyone!
Added special Vuelta kits for Arkéa B&B Hotels, Lotto, Quick Step, and Uno-X,
Updated Giro kit setups to preserve pre–Tour de France kits,
Fixed: special Giro and Vuelta kits not displaying in My Tour,
Updated national team kits for Germany, Spain, Luxembourg, and the Netherlands,
Pro Team / Leader
Adjusted form peaks so more riders are in top form during the Tour de France,
AI Behavior
Fixed: opponents entering crisis mode while still having energy,
Fixed: outsider teams chasing all day on hilly stages despite low win chance,
Fixed: favorite’s team refusing to chase when a GC threat attacks,
Fixed: dangerous GC riders attacking too early in stages,
New: GC favorites can now target stage wins on hilly stages,
Tweaked: peloton now gives a more realistic gap to morning breakaways,
Database
Updated post-Worlds and European Championships
Optimizations
Fixed MyNacon network errors,
Fixed crashes

Dear players,
After a few days in Open Beta, the major patch (versions 01.07.01 and 01.07.02) is going live and is now available for everyone!
Added Tour de France 2025 special jerseys for Bora-Hansgrohe and Israel-Premier Tech teams. \[01.07.02]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556222/eaab11b00293abbcf5a0f99cfb55cc56acccea37.png"] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556222/4f53fb15195ccbacbe3c2af54a402ddb80479bdb.png"]
Fixed jersey issues for Decathlon Ag2r La Mondiale and Lotto teams. \[01.07.02]
Legend Mode: crash detection on the roadside is now less punishing.
Slight increase in the number of riders that can be involved in a mass crash.
In short stage races with no major difficulties, there has been no early breakaways. \[01.07.02]
AI riders were experiencing fatigue even when they still have feed supplies. \[01.07.01]
Improved feed zone behavior to minimize position loss.
Improved feed behavior for domestiques: they now stop feeding if they drop too far back and will resume feeding if the race pace slows down.
Ratings update. \[01.07.02]
Leader jerseys now display correctly on the podium in Pro Team/Leader mode when playing consecutive races.
Sponsor banners may appear incorrectly on the podium when loading a save.
Commissaire’s car is too close during descents, reducing visibility.
Crash fixes.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556222/06a1278b802c070edda0b4a4229154dd4cfc9784.png"]

Hello everyone,
After a few days in Open Beta, the major patch (version 01.06.00) is going live and is now available for everyone!
New ghost appearance in Moment Descent.
New jerseys: Visma Lease a Bike, Ineos Grenadiers, Groupama FDJ, Lidl Trek.
TDF25 edition jerseys: Visma Lease a Bike, Groupama FDJ, UAE Team Emirates, Tudor, Lotto, TotalEnergies.
Adjustment: in Pro Team/Leader, T. Pogacar now targets a form peak in April instead of May.
Adjustment: in Pro Team/Leader, riders now earn Pro Cycling ranking points during team time trials.
Fix: in Pro Team/Leader, teams no longer earn too many Pro Cycling Points after a team time trial.
Fix: in Pro Team/Leader, the same stage no longer appears twice in a row.
Fix: in Pro Leader, during World Championships, the player’s teammates are no longer extremely weak.
Fix: in Pro Leader, objectives at the World Championships can no longer be completed without being selected.
Fix: the higher the difficulty, the more the Follow mode favored the player unfairly.
Fix: in My Tour, riders' recovery could become inconsistent with their stats.
New: AI effort management on the final climb of a stage has been reworked to reduce unrealistic breakdowns.
Adjustment: general classification outsiders aiming for the top 20 have more freedom to attack early in the race.
Adjustment: early breakaways set a slightly lower pace in the first climbs to stay together longer and improve their chances of winning.
Adjustment: in hilly stages, favorites manage their energy better for the final climb.
Fix: general classification outsiders make their team work even though it should be the leader teams’ responsibility.
Fix: a team chases the breakaway even though it has the strongest rider in the break.
Fix: some riders refuse to collaborate in a breakaway to protect their leader, even when there's no threat to the leader.
Fix: sometimes during the final climb, the early breakaway rides slowly and no attacks occur.
Fix: attacking with a favorite and the entire team doesn’t trigger a reaction from opponents.
Fix: in a breakaway, some riders try to take strong turns without having the energy, disrupting the relay.
Fix: special jerseys (Flanders, Giro) were not displayed in the interface.
Fix: certain special characters were not displayed in rider names.
Update: 2025 national champions.
Fix: wind zones disabled in Moment Race.
Fix: in MyTour, the starting location differs from the one selected in the menus.
Fix: TurboGel was missing for teammates.
Fix: in rankings, the player’s name was incorrect if Watts were set to 0.
Crash fixes.
Reduced memory usage in menus.
Fixes for MyNacon connection issues.
Fix: game launch issue without Steam.
Fix: improved support for Steam Input.
Added: option to limit FPS.
Added: option to select the controller display style (Xbox, PlayStation).
Added: Trading Cards are now available on Steam.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556222/cd5ed40dd1d33454b10d16a75e7f5d258e80da2d.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556222/80b3a3d560d2c375b6470cb4965aed8d01b41043.jpg"]
We are now verified!

Dear players,
After a few days in Open Beta, the major patch (version 01.04.02.1147) is going live and is now available for everyone!
Improvement: More realistic lighting and skies in stages
Improvement: More realistic transitions between grass and dirt areas
Improvement: Updated podium for fictional races
Improvement: Reduced ghosting effects of wheels in dark areas
Addition: Vuelta and Italia jerseys in MyTour influence the sponsors displayed during races
Fix: Riders flying at the start of an individual time trial
Update: Canyon frames for Movistar and Alpecin
Adjustment: Easier to stay in the wheels during the finale of a stage ending in a bunch sprint
Adjustment: Opponents no longer push the player’s riders in tight corners
Adjustment: 1 extra second of effect for TurboGel
Adjustment: 1 additional second before the automatic triggering of TurboGel
Adjustment: Slight reduction in the number of cases where leaders skip major races
Adjustment: Reduced influence of the Hills stat on cobbled climbs
Fix: Simulating Paris-Roubaix in Pro Team/Leader results in unrealistic winners
Fix: Riders do not stand on the pedals in time trials
Fix: Wind protection in sprint trains was incorrectly calculated, causing energy inconsistencies
Fix: Flèche Wallonne trophies do not unlock under the correct conditions
Fix: Incorrect display of information panels in menus
Fix: Pro Leader general classification missions can be completed in classics
Fix: “Pass a Mountain Grand Prix in the lead” missions can be validated in classics
Fix: Variant stages do not trigger
Fix: A co-leader no longer waits for a dropped co-leader to help
Fix: A good sprinter who is dropped and has no energy left is no longer waited for
Fix: In bunch sprints, riders no longer try to follow exhausted riders
Improvement: AI riders are more likely to collaborate with the player in breakaways, reducing cases where they do nothing
Improvement: Increased energy consumption for riders in the grupetto
Addition: Warning message during races when AI wants the player’s team to lead the chase
Fix: Incorrect race icon in the fitness calendar in Pro Team/Leader
Fix: Incorrect icons for “TurboGel and Attack” and “Follow Attacks” commands
Fix: “Take TurboGel and Relieve” command is unavailable even when the rider has TurboGel
Fix: Incorrect “Follow Attacks” icon after the final feeding zone
Fix: Commands are grayed out when selecting multiple riders
Fix: TurboGel effect is lost if used from the radio menu and the menu is then closed
Fix: Credits continue to scroll over other menus
Fix: Texts contain development characters
Fix: Riders switched from "starter" to "substitute" are not sorted correctly
Fix: Rider names during races are not correctly placed
Fix: In Pro Team/Leader, the game purchases the rider at the top of the list, not the one selected
Updated rider stats
Updated startlist for Critérium du Dauphiné
Updated Legends
Corrected national teams for Legends
Improvement: Automatic reconnection in the lobby when the connection is restored
Fix: All riders stop just after the finish line
Fix: “One rider per team” setting has no effect
Improvement: No longer necessary to restart the game for premium pack stages to appear
Fix: Various crash fixes
Fix: Accessing Club Tour mode without a linked MyNacon account prevents linking it afterwards
Fix: Lead car no longer clips into the road on the Roubaix velodrome
Adjustment: Available resolutions now match the screen
Adjustment: Default graphics not set to max on first launch anymore
Improvement: More explicit error message when the game does not support a graphics card
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556222/06a1278b802c070edda0b4a4229154dd4cfc9784.png"]>> https://linktr.ee/cyclinggames <<

Dear players,
A new Open Beta patch (version 01.04.02) is now available for Tour de France 2025 on PC only!
AI Behavior
Teams that missed the early breakaway no longer chase it pointlessly during mountain stages
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556222/06a1278b802c070edda0b4a4229154dd4cfc9784.png"]>> https://linktr.ee/cyclinggames <<
A huge thank you for the trust you’ve placed in us over the years with the Tour de France games. We’re beyond happy to have you as our community. Enjoy discovering Tour de France 2025 and have fun!

A new beta patch for Tour de France 2025 (version 01.04.01.1119) is now available on Steam!
You can now test it in advance via the Open Beta branch.

Go to the Betas tab and select open-beta from the dropdown
